entities.name: Multiverse
entities.description: The primary setting of Magic, composed of a finite but very large number of planes separated by the Blind Eternities and connected by Omenpaths.

entities.name: Blind Eternities
entities.description: A chaotic aether maelstrom separating the planes, traversable only by Planeswalkers and unique beings such as the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Omenpaths
entities.description: Portals between planes that began opening after the New Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: The Edge
entities.description: A ring-shaped universe bordering the Multiverse, separated from it by the Chaos Wall.

entities.name: Chaos Wall
entities.description: A physical barrier separating the Edge from the Blind Eternities.

entities.name: Drix
entities.description: Inhabitants of the Edge who posit the existence of different lamellae of creation past the Chaos Wall.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion after which Omenpaths began to open between planes.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: A planeswalker who believed the number of planes was finite but too large to count.

entities.name: Geralf Cecani
entities.description: A stitcher who described Omenpaths as trans-planar arteries and pondered their effects on non-Planeswalkers.

entities.name: Loot
entities.description: A being whose mind holds a real-time map of the entire Multiverse.

entities.name: The Wanderer
entities.description: A being who, even after losing her spark, is more aware of the planes than anyone except perhaps Loot.

entities.name: World Tree
entities.description: The source from which planes can be seen being born in Loot's map.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The world known to have been the Nexus of the Multiverse until the Mending.

entities.name: Nexus of the Multiverse
entities.description: A plane in the center of the Multiverse with great influence on other planes.

entities.name: Equilor
entities.description: An older plane than Dominaria.

entities.name: Mending
entities.description: The event after which Dominaria stopped being the Nexus of the Multiverse.

entities.name: Wrenn
entities.description: Connected to the Multiverse through Realmbreaker, she claimed to be the nexus of all that is.

entities.name: Realmbreaker
entities.description: An artifact that connected Wrenn to the Multiverse.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: A dragon who recognized the Omenpaths as a threat to Ravnica and devised a plan to regulate their access.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The plane Niv-Mizzet plans to position as a locus of the Multiverse.

entities.name: Planar Chaos
entities.description: A storyline in which the Multiverse interacted with an alternate reality.
